name: @nautilo/desktop
description: Electron desktop app — wraps the workbench in a native window with secure IPC
author: Nautilo

scripts.dev:prepare: bun run compile:screen-recording-permission && bun run compile:browser-visual-grounding && bun run vendor:bun && bun run vendor:relay-host && bun run vendor:agent-browser && bun run vendor:gog && bun run vendor:ffmpeg && bun run vendor:openhue && bun run vendor:officecli && bun run build:apply-patch && bun run vendor:ripgrep && bun run build:electron
scripts.dev: export NAUTILO_HOST=${NAUTILO_HOST:-127.0.0.1} NAUTILO_PROFILE=${NAUTILO_PROFILE:-}; bun run dev:prepare && bun run dev:launch
scripts.package:mac:build: bun run verify:cua-capability-ledger && bun run generate:icons && bun run compile:screen-recording-permission && bun run compile:browser-visual-grounding && bun run vendor:bun && bun run vendor:cua-driver && bun run vendor:computer-use-host && bun run vendor:relay-host && bun run vendor:sharp-darwin && bun run vendor:agent-browser && bun run vendor:gog && bun run vendor:ffmpeg && bun run vendor:openhue && bun run vendor:officecli && bun run vendor:ripgrep && bun run build:apply-patch:universal && bun run build && electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.package:mac: (unset APPLE_ID APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD APPLE_TEAM_ID CSC_LINK CSC_KEY_PASSWORD CSC_NAME CSC_KEYCHAIN APPLE_API_KEY APPLE_API_KEY_ID APPLE_API_ISSUER APPLE_KEYCHAIN APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE; export CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false; bun run package:mac:build -- -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=entitlements.mac.unsigned.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=entitlements.mac.unsigned.inherit.plist -c.mac.notarize=false)
scripts.package:linux: bun run generate:icons && bun run vendor:bun && bun run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:win: bun run generate:icons && bun run vendor:bun && bun run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:dev:build: bun run verify:cua-capability-ledger && bun run generate:icons && bun run compile:screen-recording-permission && bun run compile:browser-visual-grounding && bun run vendor:bun && bun run vendor:cua-driver && bun run vendor:computer-use-host && bun run vendor:relay-host && bun run vendor:sharp-darwin && bun run vendor:agent-browser && bun run vendor:gog && bun run vendor:ffmpeg && bun run vendor:openhue && bun run vendor:officecli && bun run vendor:ripgrep && bun run build:apply-patch && bun run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:dev: (unset APPLE_ID APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD APPLE_TEAM_ID CSC_LINK CSC_KEY_PASSWORD CSC_NAME CSC_KEYCHAIN APPLE_API_KEY APPLE_API_KEY_ID APPLE_API_ISSUER APPLE_KEYCHAIN APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE; export CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false; bun run package:dev:build -- -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=entitlements.mac.unsigned.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=entitlements.mac.unsigned.inherit.plist -c.mac.notarize=false)
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
